steps.title: Агрегаты и STATION 2–20
steps.content:
## Aggregation

- `COUNT`, `SUM`, `AVG`; **`CAST(AVG(...) AS INTEGER)`** — округление вниз.
- `GROUP BY`, `HAVING`, подзапросы с `MIN`/`MAX`.
- Станции 13–20: медиана через `OFFSET`, разница диапазонов, `BETWEEN`.

content.caption: GROUP BY сворачивает строки
content.description: Исключение min/max — фильтр NOT IN (min UNION max).

content.description:
Сколько записей в таблице `CITY`? Одно число.

[HackerRank: Revising Aggregations - The Count Function](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/revising-aggregations-the-count-function/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);

content.description:
Сумма `POPULATION` всех городов с `COUNTRYCODE = 'JPN'`.

[HackerRank: Revising Aggregations - The Sum Function](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/revising-aggregations-the-sum-function/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT SUM(POPULATION) FROM CITY WHERE COUNTRYCODE = 'CHN';
content.referenceSolution: SELECT SUM(POPULATION) FROM CITY WHERE COUNTRYCODE = 'JPN';

content.description:
Средняя `POPULATION` всех городов, **округлённая вниз** до целого (`CAST(AVG(...) AS INTEGER)`).

[HackerRank: Revising Aggregations - Averages](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/revising-aggregations-averages/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CAST(AVG(POPULATION) AS INTEGER) FROM CITY;

content.description:
Для каждой пары (`NAME` города как `CITY`, `DISTRICT`) средняя `POPULATION`, округлённая **вниз** до целого. Сортировка по `CITY`, затем `DISTRICT`.

[HackerRank: Average Population](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/average-population/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT NAME, DISTRICT, AVG(POPULATION) FROM CITY GROUP BY NAME, DISTRICT ORDER BY NAME, DISTRICT;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT NAME AS CITY, DISTRICT, CAST(AVG(POPULATION) AS INTEGER) FROM CITY GROUP BY NAME, DISTRICT ORDER BY NAME, DISTRICT;

content.description:
Сумма населения по каждому `DISTRICT` для `COUNTRYCODE = 'JPN'`. Сортировка по `DISTRICT`.

[HackerRank: Japan Population](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/japan-population/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT DISTRICT, SUM(POPULATION) FROM CITY WHERE COUNTRYCODE = 'CHN' GROUP BY DISTRICT ORDER BY DISTRICT;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT DISTRICT, SUM(POPULATION) FROM CITY WHERE COUNTRYCODE = 'JPN' GROUP BY DISTRICT ORDER BY DISTRICT;

content.description:
Разница между **максимальной** и **минимальной** плотностью (`POPULATION / SURFACEAREA`) среди стран `CONTINENT = 'Asia'`. Округлите до ближайшего целого.

[HackerRank: Population Density Difference](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/population-density-difference/problem)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE COUNTRY(CODE TEXT PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, CONTINENT TEXT NOT NULL, REGION TEXT NOT NULL, SURFACEAREA REAL NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE CITY(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, COUNTRYCODE TEXT NOT NULL, DISTRICT TEXT NOT NULL, POPULATION INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT MAX(C.POPULATION * 1.0 / CO.SURFACEAREA) - MIN(C.POPULATION * 1.0 / CO.SURFACEAREA) FROM CITY C JOIN COUNTRY CO ON C.COUNTRYCODE = CO.CODE WHERE CO.CONTINENT = 'Europe';

content.description:
Сamantha посчитала среднюю зарплату, **удалив все нули** из строкового представления зарплаты. Верните `CEIL(истинное среднее) - CEIL(искажённое среднее)`.

[HackerRank: The Blunder](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/the-blunder/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE EMPLOYEES(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, SALARY INTEGER NOT NULL);

content.description:
Максимальная зарплата и число сотрудников с **этой** зарплатой. Колонки: `salary`, `count`.

[HackerRank: Top Earners](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/top-earners/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE EMPLOYEES(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, NAME TEXT NOT NULL, SALARY INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT MAX(SALARY) AS salary, COUNT(*) AS count FROM EMPLOYEES;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT SALARY AS salary, COUNT(*) AS count FROM EMPLOYEES GROUP BY SALARY ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1;

content.description:
Средние `LAT_N` и `LONG_W` по таблице `STATION`, каждое округлено до **2** знаков.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 2](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-2/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);

content.description:
Сумма `LAT_N` по `STATION`, **исключив** глобальный минимум и максимум широты.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 13](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-13/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT SUM(LAT_N) FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N NOT IN (SELECT MIN(LAT_N) FROM STATION UNION SELECT MAX(LAT_N) FROM STATION);

content.description:
Средняя `LAT_N` (округлить до **2** знаков) среди станций с `LAT_N > 38.2445`. Одно число.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 14](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-14/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT ROUND(AVG(LAT_N), 2) FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N > 38.2445 AND LONG_W > 0;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT ROUND(AVG(LAT_N), 2) FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N > 38.2445;

content.description:
Город с **максимальной** `LAT_N` среди **западного полушария** (`LONG_W < 0`) и **северного** (`LAT_N > 0`). Колонки `CITY`, `LAT_N`, `LONG_W`.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 15](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-15/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT CITY, LAT_N, LONG_W FROM STATION WHERE LONG_W < 0 ORDER BY LAT_N LIMIT 1;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CITY, LAT_N, LONG_W FROM STATION WHERE LONG_W < 0 AND LAT_N > 0 ORDER BY LAT_N DESC LIMIT 1;

content.description:
Станции с `LAT_N > 38.7880` и `LONG_W > 77.2318`. `LAT_N` — целая часть (truncate), `LONG_W` — округление **вверх** до 2 знаков (`CEIL(x*100)/100.0`). Сортировка по `LAT_N`.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 16](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-16/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT ROUND(LAT_N, 2), ROUND(LONG_W, 2) FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N > 38.7880 AND LONG_W > 77.2318 ORDER BY LAT_N;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CAST(LAT_N AS INTEGER) AS LAT_N, CEIL(LONG_W * 100) / 100.0 AS LONG_W FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N > 38.7880 AND LONG_W > 77.2318 ORDER BY LAT_N;

content.description:
Сумма `LAT_N` для станций с `LAT_N` между `38.7880` и `137.234` и `LONG_W` между `-122.477` и `-45.756` (включительно). Округлите до **2** знаков.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 17](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-17/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT SUM(LAT_N) FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N > 38.7880 AND LAT_N < 137.234;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT ROUND(SUM(LAT_N), 2) FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N BETWEEN 38.7880 AND 137.234 AND LONG_W BETWEEN -122.477 AND -45.756;

content.description:
Города **не** из Калифорнии (`STATE <> 'CA'`). Сортировка по `CITY`.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 18](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-18/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT CITY FROM STATION WHERE STATE = 'CA' ORDER BY CITY;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT CITY FROM STATION WHERE STATE <> 'CA' ORDER BY CITY;

content.description:
Разница между `(MAX(LAT_N) - MIN(LAT_N))` и `(MAX(LONG_W) - MIN(LONG_W))` по `STATION`. Округлите до **4** знаков.

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 19](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-19/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT ROUND((MAX(LAT_N) - MIN(LAT_N)) - (MAX(LONG_W) - MIN(LONG_W)), 4) FROM STATION;

content.description:
**Медиана** `LAT_N` для северных станций (`LAT_N > 0`). Одно число, округлённое до **4** знаков (нижний средний элемент при чётном числе строк).

[HackerRank: Weather Observation Station 20](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/weather-observation-station-20/problem)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE STATION(ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, CITY TEXT NOT NULL, STATE TEXT NOT NULL, LAT_N REAL NOT NULL, LONG_W REAL NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT AVG(LAT_N) FROM STATION WHERE LAT_N > 0;

content.question: Чем `COUNT(*)` отличается от `COUNT(DISTINCT col)`?
options: COUNT(*) считает строки, COUNT(DISTINCT) — уникальные значения
